home.title: Migration batches and routing
home.lead: Create a batch, dry-run it, start it with a second manager's approval, and reverse it when needed. Routing shows which system is master for a policy on a date.
home.noRecent: Batches you create or open appear here
home.name: Batch name
home.itemsHelp: A JSON array of objects with module, objectType, legacyId and payload; at most 5,000 items.
home.itemsInvalid: Enter a non-empty JSON array of items with module, objectType, legacyId and payload.

help.dryRunNeeded: Run a dry run first. A real run needs a dry run of the same content and a second manager's approval.
help.dryRunDone: The dry run matches the content. Starting asks a second manager for approval.
help.pendingApproval: Started by {who}. A different migration manager decides: the approver cannot be the person who started the batch.
help.reverse: A dry-run reversal shows which items can be reversed. Items with later activity are blocked.

confirm.title: Please confirm
confirm.start: This sends the batch for approval. After approval it imports the items into the core system.
confirm.reverse: This reverses the imported items of the batch. Items with later activity stay and are marked as blocked.

routing.title: Routing
routing.help: Which system is master for an object on a date. Each lookup is added to the timeline below.
routing.noRoute: No route: legacy system is master
